$comment: Library catalog (R-LIB-6). The single source of what Jjodel shares, until an administration service replaces this file with the same schema. kind: sealedNotation (case 1, a complete language used through the model editor only) or galleryProject (case 2, a project the user clones and owns). status: planned (decided, not built), deferred (decided for later). publisher is always jjodel until R-LIB-3 opens the gallery to others.

entries.label: State machine (UML statechart)
